newsitem.title: USA: NOVEN SAYS NDA FOR COMBINATION PATCH FILED.
newsitem.headline: NOVEN SAYS NDA FOR COMBINATION PATCH FILED.

text.p: Noven Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc has submitted new drug applications to regulatory authorities in the U.S. and the European Union for a combination estrogen/progestogen skin patch.
This combination transdermal system is developed by Noven and licensed to Rhone-Poulenc on a worldwide basis.

In the U.S., Rhone-Poulenc has submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration seeking approval for the relief of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms associated with menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats.
The Marketing Authorization Application submitted in Europe seeks approval for prevention of post-menopausal osteoporosis as well as relief of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms.
